containment: Host UI automation stays unavailable. Route the work through the verified API lane, or through the managed browser profile after a named API failure predicate is recorded. Do not retry the host lane; the missing grant is a host permission the agent cannot give itself.
reenable_criteria: The operator grants the permission out of band, the declared probe passes, and the capability row moves to ready with fresh evidence.
note: The ledger is what makes a degraded-but-contained state auditable over time. Containment text is rendered into the generated operator view from this entry, so a disabled lane cannot be silently rediscovered as available.
